title: PeerStatusView
description: Source of truth: Holochain infrastructure DNA DHT (Notarized, Category A). This view is a read-optimized projection from the peer_statuses SQLite table, itself populated by InfrastructureSignal::PeerStatusRecorded post-commit projections. If the projection and the DHT disagree, the DHT wins.

peerId.description: Agent pubkey of the peer (base64url encoded). Matches the agent_pub_key in the infrastructure DNA

status.description: Peer availability status as last advertised via heartbeat

generalPoolMember.description: True when this peer is available to serve as a general-pool request target. Used by the doorway forwarder for candidate selection

acceptingStewardshipReserves.description: True when this peer is accepting new stewardship reserve allocations

archetypeClass.description: Operator-declared node archetype. E.g. home-nuc, blade, desktop, cloud-vps. Null when the peer has not declared an archetype

timestamp.description: Holochain action timestamp in microseconds since Unix epoch (u64 as string — exceeds JS safe integer range)

dhtAnchorHash.description: ActionHash of the PeerStatus DHT entry this projection was built from (base64url). Allows callers to verify provenance against the DHT

updatedAt.description: Unix microseconds when this projection row was last written (u64 as string)

elohimCapability.description: If this peer runs an elohim-agent, this block advertises its model-level capabilities. Null or absent means no elohim runs here (e.g., pure storage/relay node). Operator-configured in Phase 9; auto-detected in Phase 10+
